how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stranglethorn-vale-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:185:obj:0: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Stranglethorn Tigers.
rows.quest:185:details:0: When I was but a young girl, my father trained me in the art of tiger hunting.
rows.quest:185:details:1: BYou'll find the young felines much easier to track and slay. For this reason, we'll start you out easy. One can often find young tigers near the expedition camp.
rows.quest:185:details:2: BTest your tracking skills and see if you can hunt some of the beasts down.
rows.quest:185:completion:0: Nicely done, ⟦1⟧. You are ready to move on.
rows.quest:186:obj:0: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
rows.quest:186:details:0: You are learning, ⟦2⟧. Let us test your skills with the mature cats now. Kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers this time out.
rows.quest:186:completion:0: I am impressed, ⟦3⟧. You are progressing quite well.
rows.quest:187:obj:0: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers.
rows.quest:187:details:0: Now I'm going to up the stakes on you and truly test your skill. Prove to me you can kill 10 Elder Stranglethorn Tigers. If you can do that, you will be ready for your final challenge before I declare you a master tiger hunter in Master Nesingwary's presence.
rows.quest:187:details:1: BElder Stranglethorn Tigers are not only the most difficult to find, they are also the fiercest to defeat.
rows.quest:187:completion:0: Most impressive. I believe you are almost ready.
rows.quest:188:obj:0: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill Sin'Dall and return with her paw.
rows.quest:188:details:0: Here is the final challenge that I will put forth. We've been tracking an elusive tiger for weeks. We call the beast Sin'Dall. See if you can do what no ⟦4⟧ has done before: hunt down and kill Sin'Dall. Bring me her paw as proof of your accomplishment.
rows.quest:188:details:1: BTracking her down will be no easy task.
rows.quest:188:completion:0: Most impressive, I do say! You are a true Master Tiger Hunter, ⟦5⟧!
rows.quest:189:obj:0: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:189:details:0: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?
rows.quest:189:details:1: BDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... ⟦6⟧, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!
rows.quest:189:details:2: BHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.
rows.quest:189:completion:0: Oh excellent, excellent. That'll help a little, for the present...
rows.quest:189:completion:1: B<He trails off, grumbling about profit margins and costs...>
rows.quest:189:completion:2: BWhat? You're still here? Reward? Oh, right... of course, here, take this... it should be more than enough.
rows.quest:190:obj:0: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Young Panthers.
rows.quest:190:details:0: If you want to be a part of the hunt with this crack group under Hemet's leadership, you're going to need to prove yourself an able panther hunter. We'll start you out easy -- don't you worry. Let's see you kill 10 young panthers to start.
rows.quest:190:details:1: BTracking them down is only half the challenge...
rows.quest:191:obj:0: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Panthers.
rows.quest:191:details:0: Now you're ready to turn it up a notch. If you want to prove yourself worthy of socializing with the likes of these big game hunters, you'll need to prove that you can kill 10 panthers.
rows.quest:191:details:1: BThose big boys are tougher. They're not as easy as the young ones you were killing earlier.
rows.quest:192:obj:0: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Shadowmaw Panthers.
rows.quest:192:details:0: Now the hard part. A true panther hunter can show skill by dropping Shadowmaw Panthers, the deadliest in Stranglethorn. Prove to us that you can slay 10 of these beasts.
rows.quest:192:details:1: BIf you think they are hard to track, wait until you attempt to slay one....
rows.quest:193:obj:0: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to bring him the Fang of Bhag'thera.
rows.quest:193:details:0: You've almost proven yourself to be a master hunter of panthers. A panther by the name of Bhag'thera has been prowling the jungle. So far he's eluded our party. See if you can use your skills to kill the great Bhag'thera.
rows.quest:193:details:1: BBring me the Fang of Bhag'thera and you'll have earned my respect!
rows.quest:193:completion:0: So the great Bhag'thera is dead! Cheers to you, ⟦10⟧. You are a mighty ⟦11⟧ indeed!
rows.quest:194:obj:0: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
rows.quest:194:details:0: So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape? I can put them to the test in a jiffy. Head out into that jungle and kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors. We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.
rows.quest:194:details:1: BAnd no, I won't tell you where you can find them! Locating the beasts is half the challenge.
rows.quest:195:obj:0: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Lashtail Raptors.
rows.quest:195:details:0: Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it. Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors. Let's see what you've got!
rows.quest:195:completion:0: Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth! Nice killing, ⟦12⟧!
rows.quest:196:obj:0: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Jungle Stalkers.
rows.quest:196:details:0: Let's see how you handle this next challenge. There is a cagey breed of raptor out there. We call them Jungle Stalkers. They are far more difficult to track down and kill than the other breeds you've been trying your luck at. Kill 10 Jungle Stalkers and I'll tip you off to the best hunting yet.
rows.quest:196:completion:0: Ho ho!! We have ourselves a true raptor slayer! Nicely done, old chap!
rows.quest:197:obj:0: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill Tethis, an elusive, dangerous raptor in Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:197:details:0: Because you proved yourself to be such a go-getter in the jungle, let me tell you about a ferocious raptor that even I have failed to kill. Ajeck here calls this wily raptor Tethis.
rows.quest:197:details:1: BIf you want to prove yourself a true master, kill Tethis and bring me his talon. It would be a feat that no other big game hunter has accomplished.
rows.quest:197:completion:1: BHas a nice ring to it, eh?
rows.quest:198:obj:0: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.
rows.quest:198:details:0: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.
rows.quest:198:details:1: BThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from ⟦E1⟧. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.
rows.quest:198:details:2: BMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.
rows.quest:198:completion:0: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?
rows.quest:200:details:0: If Kurzen knows Thorsen's secret, then we have a spy in our midst. We must determine how the secret was leaked!
rows.quest:200:details:1: BThorsen's contact within Kurzen's camp was Bookie Herod. Herod is Kurzen's logistics officer and knows everything about the running of Kurzen's Compound. If you can get Herod's notes or records, maybe we can find out how Thorsen was discovered.
rows.quest:200:details:2: BWhen we were still with Kurzen, Bookie's office was on the top floor of the camp's only two-story house. His records are probably still there.
rows.quest:200:completion:0: These are Bookie Herod's notes and records.
rows.quest:200:completion:1: BAmong them are: a list of supplies within the camp, material requests from Colonel Kurzen, and various letters and correspondences.
rows.quest:201:obj:0: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:201:details:0: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there. He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.
rows.quest:201:details:1: BWhy don't you go check out the camp, ⟦14⟧, see what they're about?
rows.quest:201:completion:0: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual. Interesting. Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products. Hmmm...
rows.quest:202:obj:0: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:202:details:0: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself. You may be the ⟦E2⟧ of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!
rows.quest:202:details:1: BHe commands his men from deep within the Stockpile. You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.
rows.quest:202:details:2: BFarewell, ⟦15⟧. My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.
rows.quest:202:completion:0: I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that... Kurzen and his leaders are defeated. You have saved us!
rows.quest:202:completion:1: BThese jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen. We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
rows.quest:203:obj:1: BReturn to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:203:details:0: We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen. Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1! To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.
rows.quest:203:details:1: BEnter his camp to the east and kill his men. Lots of them. And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
rows.quest:203:completion:0: Well done. The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.
rows.quest:203:completion:1: BBut now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
rows.quest:204:obj:0: Bring 7 Jungle Remedies and 1 Venom Fern Extract to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:204:details:0: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized. He has gathered a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts.
rows.quest:204:details:1: BWe need those remedies and extracts for our own. Search the Kurzen Compound - his Medicine Men and Jungle fighers will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
rows.quest:204:completion:0: Well done, ⟦16⟧. These remedies will keep more of us alive and in fighting shape. And the extracts will help us create our own remedies.
rows.quest:205:obj:0: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:205:details:0: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic. Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
rows.quest:205:completion:0: Thank you. I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
rows.quest:206:obj:0: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:206:details:0: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives! Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn. He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.
rows.quest:206:details:1: BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.
rows.quest:206:details:2: BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
rows.quest:206:completion:0: Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, ⟦17⟧, and may your strength never fade!
rows.quest:206:completion:1: BI will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not... then it must be destroyed.
rows.quest:207:obj:0: Find the 4 tablets and bring their legends back to Brother Nimetz.
rows.quest:207:details:0: Colonel Kurzen was once a great, noble man - I must find what caused his fall into depravity! He may be under the sway of troll magic. To confirm this, I must study some of their legends.
rows.quest:207:details:1: BThere are 4 tablets hidden within the troll ruins of Stranglethorn. I must see what is written on these tablets! Transcribe their markings and bring the transcriptions back to me.
rows.quest:207:details:2: BThe first tablet is in the Bal'lal Ruins, the second is in the Vile Reef, and the third and fourth are in the Ruins of Zul'Kunda.
rows.quest:207:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦18⟧. I will study these legends to see if there is some link between the trolls and the evil that has possessed Colonel Kurzen.
rows.quest:208:obj:0: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to bring him the head of King Bangalash, the great white tiger.
rows.quest:208:details:0: ⟦19⟧, you are a hunter worthy of our company. From the battlefields of Lordaeron to the deepest jungle, I have rarely witnessed such prowess with weaponry as you have demonstrated.
rows.quest:208:details:1: BYou have killed the ferocious Sin'Dall, the elusive Bag'thera and the treacherous Tethis. But the true prize is the head of King Bangalash. That white tiger is the reason I am here. I've had my sights on him for quite some time now. Kill King Bangalash and your hunting prowess is proven to be second to none.
rows.quest:208:completion:0: Bloody well done! Right-o! Congratulations, ⟦20⟧, for succeeding where others have failed.
rows.quest:208:completion:1: BI am honored to count you as a comrade of our great hunting party here. No one will ever doubt your expertise in hunting and tracking!
rows.quest:208:completion:2: BCheers to you, I say! Cheers!
rows.quest:209:obj:0: Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
rows.quest:209:details:0: It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.
rows.quest:209:details:1: BThe closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.
rows.quest:209:details:2: BHey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!
rows.quest:209:completion:0: Ah, good work, good work! Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! My thanks to you, ⟦21⟧, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! Good good, now, onto other matters...
rows.quest:210:obj:0: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
rows.quest:210:details:0: I do most of the cooking at the camp. And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay. The pot is a wonder! It saved me countless hours...until it broke!
rows.quest:210:details:1: BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it? His name is Krazek.
rows.quest:210:completion:0: Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot! An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then. Let me see what's wrong with this one...
rows.quest:210:completion:1: BAha! Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth. I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state!
rows.quest:210:completion:2: BCan I fix it? Of course I can fix it!
rows.quest:210:completion:3: BBut there's a price. Oh yes, there is always a price...
rows.quest:213:obj:0: Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:213:details:0: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!
rows.quest:213:details:1: BRevilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.
rows.quest:213:details:2: BMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.
rows.quest:213:completion:0: Fascinating. That the crystals have been tumbled using this process can only indicate that they are planning to use them as some sort of fuel or other catalyst. I don't know much more than that. Samples will have to be dispatched to Head Chemist Gigglefont.
rows.quest:215:obj:0: Speak with Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:215:details:0: Thank you for saving me, ⟦22⟧. I know how this looks, but...allow me to explain.
rows.quest:215:details:1: BI was charged by Lieutenant Doren to re-enlist with Kurzen's men, so that I might spy on them and bring sorely needed intelligence to the rebels. You saw here what I had thought would be my chance to infiltrate Kurzen's Compound. I was wrong, and again, thanks for saving me.
rows.quest:215:details:2: BThis was a top secret mission, so you must tell no one. But if you speak with Doren he will explain.
rows.quest:215:completion:0: Yes, what Thorsen told you is true. You must be discrete with this. At one time, we rebels were fiercely loyal to Colonel Kurzen. But such was Kurzen's corruption, our passion twisted into rage. If it was made known that Private Thorsen has had recent dealings with Kurzen's men, then one night he would find himself with a slit throat.
rows.quest:215:completion:1: BTo my knowledge, only Sergeant Yohwa, Thorsen and I were privy to Thorsen's mission. But there must be another. A traitor.
rows.quest:328:obj:0: Use the Small Brass Key to open Bookie Herod's Strongbox.
rows.quest:328:details:0: Although no mention of Private Thorsen is found in these records, hidden within the binding of one of Herod's ledger books is a small, brass key.
rows.quest:328:details:1: BAnd after further study of his notes, a few references to a "secure strongbox" are contained among various papers. The box is somewhere within the Stockpile - the cavern complex at the back of Kurzen's Compound.
rows.quest:328:details:2: BIf this secure strongbox is found, and the small brass key can open it, then perhaps the mystery behind Thorsen's detection will be revealed.
rows.quest:328:completion:0: Opening the strongbox, it's clear that this is where Herod keeps his more valuable coins and items.
rows.quest:329:obj:0: Take the Muddy Note to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:329:details:0: Among the valuables of the strongbox is a muddy, scribbled note. Although barely legible, it looks to be an itinerary for Private Thorsen. It details his patrol routes, who he speaks with and how he spends his time with the rebels. It's signed with only one letter: -M.
rows.quest:329:details:1: BBut whoever wrote this note must have stayed very close to Thorsen. Whoever wrote this note is the traitor within the rebel camp.
rows.quest:329:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦23⟧. This note is the clue we need to root out the traitor!
rows.quest:330:details:0: The note you gave me is signed with an "-M"...I don't know what that could mean.
rows.quest:330:details:1: BBut...the note also says this person shared patrol routes with Thorsen last week. So whoever shared patrol with Thorsen last week must be the traitor!
rows.quest:330:details:2: BGo to Corporal Sethman. He handles the patrol schedules and can tell you who was with Thorsen.
rows.quest:330:completion:0: Oh, yes I can check that for you. Let's see...last week it was...
rows.quest:330:completion:1: B...why, it was Private Merle scheduled with Thorsen. They had the same patrol times all of last week.
rows.quest:331:details:0: Did Lieutenant Doren want you to report back to him with that patrol information?
rows.quest:331:completion:0: It pains me to find out it was Merle who betrayed us. He has always been a brave soldier, and I had thought his heart was true. But it is a great relief to have found him out - with a spy like him among us...we would not last long against Colonel Kurzen.
rows.quest:338:obj:0: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.
rows.quest:338:details:0: Master Nesingwary will be so upset if he finds out!
rows.quest:338:details:1: BHe trusted me to proofread the manuscript of his novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Everything was going well, but a large gust of wind blew through the camp and scattered the pages everywhere!
rows.quest:338:details:2: BI was able to gather most of the pages but many are still strewn about the jungle. Collect the pages to complete each of the four chapters.
rows.quest:338:details:3: BI will help you organize them. Return the chapters to me once you have all four.
rows.quest:338:completion:0: You've certainly saved me a heap of trouble, ⟦24⟧! I can't thank you enough. It shouldn't be long now until we see Master Nesingwary's book in libraries throughout the world!
rows.quest:339:obj:0: Bring pages 1, 4, 6, and 8 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter I.
rows.quest:339:details:0: Chapter I was quite riveting! Master Nesingwary sets the backdrop for the story and makes mention of his hunting companions, including me!
rows.quest:339:details:1: BBut that's besides the point. Let me see which pages are still missing. It seems pages 1, 4, 6 and 8 are still out there somewhere in the jungle!
rows.quest:339:completion:0: At last! Chapter I is complete!
rows.quest:340:obj:0: Bring pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter II.
rows.quest:340:details:0: Chapter II was chock full of exciting tales of panther and tiger hunting. I could just kick myself for letting the pages blow away!
rows.quest:340:details:1: B It seems I was able to recover all of the pages with the exception of pages 10, 11, 14, and 16.
rows.quest:340:completion:0: Chapter II is finally complete! Well done!
rows.quest:341:obj:0: Bring pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.
rows.quest:341:details:0: Chapter III was my favorite. It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle. And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!
rows.quest:341:details:1: BLooks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter. Those pages are out there somewhere. . .
rows.quest:341:completion:0: Phew! Good work, ⟦25⟧. Chapter III is now back together in one piece!
rows.quest:342:obj:0: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.
rows.quest:342:details:0: Ah Chapter IV; the big finale! And what an ending it was!
rows.quest:342:details:1: BWe are only missing three pages for this chapter. We need pages 25, 26 and 27 to put Chapter IV back together.
rows.quest:342:completion:0: Superb! We now have Chapter IV ready to go!
rows.quest:348:obj:0: Seek out Witch Doctor Unbagwa and have him summon Mokk the Savage. Bring the Heart of Mokk to Fin Fizracket.
rows.quest:348:details:2: B...only cure...is...is...to eat the heart of M-m-m-m-mokk the Savage...elusive white beast...
rows.quest:348:details:3: B...Witch doctor Unbagwa...only one who can s-s-summon....
rows.quest:348:details:4: B...seek Unbagwa in hidden cave on southern cape...
rows.quest:348:completion:1: BWhere might be? Booty Bay? Oh my! I had the strangest dream...
rows.quest:348:completion:2: B...the weakness has not completely left me....
rows.quest:568:obj:0: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 15 Lashtail Raptors.
rows.quest:568:details:1: BYour arrival at Grom'gol is timely, indeed. As commander of the Warchief's base camp here in the jungle I am bound by honor to ensure the safety of all members of the ⟦E3⟧. Our mission to provide a safe chain of supply to Stonard is being hampered by some of the local inhabitants.
rows.quest:568:details:2: BI am putting you in charge of thinning out the raptor population outside of Grom'gol. Once you have made significant progress, report back to me for reassignment.
rows.quest:568:completion:0: Your duty was performed with honor, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:569:obj:0: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill 10 Ogre Brutes and 5 Ogre Witch Doctors.
rows.quest:569:details:0: When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes. Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority. But complications have arisen. A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol. Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.
rows.quest:569:details:1: BI am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.
rows.quest:569:details:2: BTravel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area. At the very least it will send a firm message.
rows.quest:569:completion:0: Well done. You have served the Warchief with honor.
rows.quest:570:obj:0: Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp wants 8 Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.
rows.quest:570:details:0: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the ⟦E3⟧. My rituals have proven successful so far. I can cast very powerful enchantments. For you, brave ⟦28⟧, I shall make a special item indeed.
rows.quest:570:details:1: BBring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang. Not just any fang will do. It must be in pristine condition.
rows.quest:570:details:2: BThe beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.
rows.quest:570:completion:0: Your knowledge of the jungle is strong, ⟦29⟧. These specimens will be perfect. I will thank the spirits for sacrificing such fine beasts for the cause of the ⟦E3⟧.
